content: This information is not intended to replace the advice of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive details about this product and how it pertains to your specific health needs. Missed Dose: If you forget to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Storage Instructions: Keep the product in its original packaging at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Once the foil pouch is opened, the product expires after 60 days in the United States and 45 days in Canada. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for you. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your individual health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary details, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions to access the offer.
